title: Planner: Planner Agent in group-based basic plans
summary: Hold: the note about turning Planner Agent on for all users omits an existing security-group restriction. Microsoft documents that AllowPlannerCopilot set to true still restricts access when a group ID is configured; the other commands, licence requirement and roadmap facts are supported.

claims.claim: Planner Agent is available for Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users in all group-based Planner plans, including basic plans.
claims.quote: Planner Agent will now be available for M365 Copilot licensed users in all group-based Planner plans, including basic plans.

claims.claim: The Planner Agent features basic plans gain include task execution and status reporting.
claims.quote: This expands access to Planner Agent features such as task execution and status reporting within basic plans, enhancing productivity without requiring plan upgrades.

claims.where: What's changing; Cost and licensing; Risk assessment
claims.claim: Premium capabilities in unified plans increasingly depend on each user's assigned licence.
claims.quote: Premium capabilities are increasingly available in unified plans based on the licenses assigned to individual users.

claims.claim: Members of a unified plan need not hold the same licence.
claims.quote: A unified plan doesn't require every member of the plan to have the same license. Users can collaborate in the same plan, while the capabilities available to each user depend on their assigned license.

claims.where: What's changing; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Planner for admins says Microsoft Copilot includes premium and AI-powered capabilities such as Planner Agent.
claims.quote: For example, users with Microsoft Copilot can use premium and AI-powered capabilities included with that license, such as Planner Agent, Goals, task scheduling, task history, and task dependencies.

claims.claim: Planner Agent chat is a distinct capability from Planner Agent task execution and status reporting.
claims.quote: The Planner Agent automates plan creation and task execution for teams. The Planner Agent chat in premium plans (previously "Copilot in Planner") offers an in-app natural language chat experience

claims.claim: Planner basic capabilities are included in qualifying Microsoft 365 plans.
claims.quote: Which Microsoft 365 plans include Planner and its basic capabilities? Planner in Microsoft 365 is included with the following subscription plans:

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the untouched tenant default for Planner Agent or AllowPlannerCopilot.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Planner AllowPlannerCopilot default tenant PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId default'; opened turn-off-planner-agent, planner-for-admins and manage-copilot-agents-integrated-apps. The matrix describes configured values, not an untouched tenant's value.

claims.claim: No admin UI switch for Planner Agent in Planner is documented; the documented switch is PowerShell.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Planner Agent in Planner basic plans admin center disable restrict security group UI AllowPlannerCopilot default enabled'; opened turn-off-planner-agent and manage-copilot-agents-integrated-apps. Results distinguish the Planner app from Copilot agents and the Cowork plugin.

claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false turns Planner Agent off for all users.
claims.quote: To turn off Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for all users: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false

claims.claim: Setting AllowPlannerCopilot to $true turns Planner Agent on for all users without further qualification.
claims.quote: $true | $null (00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000) | 'ON' for all users; $true | valid security group ID | 'ON' for users in the security group only (or nested members); $true | invalid security group ID | 'OFF' for all users
claims.fix: Replace '$true turns it on for all users.' in controls[0].note and its rendered table note with 'With PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId set to $null, $true turns it on for all users.' The qualification is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/planner/turn-off-planner-agent.

claims.claim: No admin UI for restricting Planner Agent in Planner to a security group is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Planner Agent in Planner basic plans admin center disable restrict security group UI AllowPlannerCopilot default enabled'; opened turn-off-planner-agent and manage-copilot-agents-integrated-apps. No UI for PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId was documented.

claims.where: controls[1].api; summary; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id> restricts access to a security group.
claims.quote: To turn on Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for a specific security group: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id>

claims.claim: The allowed security group includes members of nested groups.
claims.quote: Users who are members of the specified security group, including those in nested groups, will have access.

claims.claim: An invalid security group ID denies access to all users even with AllowPlannerCopilot set to $true.
claims.quote: If the Security Group ID is invalid, no users will have access, even if AllowPlannerCopilot is set to $true.

claims.claim: Licence assignment is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Users > Active users page. ... Select the row of the user ... In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps. ... Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a user licence.
claims.quote: To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell. Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least a License or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.
